key_provisions_or_claims: Law on AI passed 10 Dec 2025 with 90.70% approval; effective 1 March 2026.
35 articles; 'manage to develop' approach balancing risk control and innovation.
Risk-based classification of AI systems with obligations for high-risk uses (finance, health, justice, labour, education).
Human-centred: AI serves humans, human oversight in important decisions.
National AI Development Fund, AI vouchers, controlled sandbox, national AI workforce strategy.
annotation.summary_en: Ministry of Science and Technology news item reporting the National Assembly's 10 December 2025 passage of Vietnam's first AI Law (35 articles, effective 1 March 2026). It describes a risk-based, human-centred framework with human oversight, sandboxes, a national AI fund, vouchers and workforce development.
